name: Vasudev Siddh
headline: AI & Full-Stack Engineer
summary: AI engineering intern who builds LLM, voice AI, and full-stack products with Python and TypeScript, from first prototype to tested release. Creator of JustHireMe, an open-source AI job-search app with 2,200+ GitHub stars.

bullets: Use Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js, and WebRTC to build real-time voice AI, so users can hold natural, low-delay conversations with an AI assistant.
Add automated evaluations and regression tests so LLM changes are checked before they reach users; build data-access controls that limit who sees which data.
Use Python, FastAPI, MongoDB, and vector search to build AI search that finds relevant results from both text and images.
Set up automated tests and CI/CD with Docker and AWS, so every change is tested and deployed the same way.

projects.name: JustHireMe
projects.label: Creator / Open source
bullets: Built an open-source desktop app with Python, FastAPI, React, and Rust that finds jobs, explains how well each one fits you, and drafts tailored applications; 2,200+ GitHub stars.
Ranked jobs with graph and vector search plus quality checks, with human review before any generated document is used.

projects.name: Odeon
projects.label: Solo build / Agent evaluation
bullets: Built a tool with Python, FastAPI, and React that tests an AI agent with difficult simulated conversations, has an LLM grade its behavior, and rewrites its prompt until the scores pass.
Streams each run live with a word-by-word diff of every prompt change, so it is easy to see what changed.

projects.name: Waldo
projects.label: Solo build / Multimodal RAG
bullets: Built a chat tool with Python, LangGraph, Gemini, and Qdrant that answers questions about PDFs, including their tables and figures, and shows the source figure with each answer.
Checks if retrieved content is relevant, retries with a rewritten question, and says it does not know rather than guessing.
